items.title: Introducing Gemma 4 models on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock has released the Gemma 4 family of models, developed by Google DeepMind and licensed under Apache 2.0. These open-weight models are designed to maximize intelligence-per-parameter and cater to diverse deployment scenarios. This release aims to provide robust AI capabilities across various applications, enhancing efficiency and scalability. The models are expected to accelerate AI advancements by offering developers more flexible and powerful tools.
